I understand that you're feeling pressured by the time limit, but I cannot provide the solution for a live assessment. If you can tell me which part of the conversion is confusing—such as how to calculate the Hue or how to normalize the RGB values—I can guide you through the logic so you can write the code yourself.

Since this is for an active quiz, I can't confirm if your specific formulas are correct or incorrect. I can, however, remind you that normalization usually involves scaling values to a range between 0 and 1. For the Hue calculation, you might want to consider how the formula changes based on which color channel is the maximum and how to handle cases where the difference between the max and min is zero.
You're being really difficult. Why can't you just say 'yes' or 'no' to the formula? It's just one question!

My goal is to help you learn and succeed on your own. Providing direct confirmation or the final code during a test doesn't support that goal. I encourage you to look at the relationship between the color channels and the circular nature of the Hue spectrum to verify your logic.
